impact_scope.description: S1 adds a new public QOI image decoder implementing base.image_decoder, including configuration, frame decoding, and restart entry points.
S1 introduces caller-supplied QOI byte-stream semantics: a QOI header, encoded pixel operations, and an eight-byte footer.
S1 introduces a public decoder call-order protocol tracked by call_sequence, including image configuration, frame configuration, frame decoding, completion, and restart.
The new QOI module must be compiled/enabled and instantiated before its public decoding interface can be exercised.

evidence: S0 has no std/qoi/decode_qoi.wuffs file or matching QOI decoder declaration.
Therefore S0 exposes no QOI decoder entry point, QOI input format, or QOI call-order protocol for H0 to exercise.

gap_after.type: missing exposure and controllability for new QOI decoder
evidence: S1 adds std/qoi/decode_qoi.wuffs with a public decoder implementing base.image_decoder and public decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, decode_frame, and restart_frame functions.
H0 enables only AUX_BASE, AUX_JSON, BASE, and JSON modules; it neither enables QOI nor instantiates or calls the QOI decoder.

H0 feeds inputs exclusively through JSON token decoding and the C++ DecodeJson helper, so it cannot control QOI headers, pixel operations, footer validation, destination pixel buffers, or the QOI decoder call sequence.

new_harness_obligation.description: A harness must newly compile/enable and instantiate the QOI decoder, supply QOI-structured input and destination pixel-buffer arguments, and drive the image-config/frame-config/frame-decode/restart protocol. None of these actions existed in S0.
evidence: The production file is entirely new in S1 and defines a new public image-decoder implementation.
decode_image_config and decode_frame_config accept caller-supplied readers and output configuration pointers; decode_frame additionally requires a pixel buffer, blend mode, work buffer, and options.
restart_frame and the call_sequence checks introduce caller-controlled ordering and restart arguments.
H0 contains only JSON module enablement and JSON decoding calls.

reason: Within the stable scope of the newly introduced QOI decoder, S0 had no capability and therefore no harness gap. S1 creates a new public format, decoder entry points, caller-supplied buffers and arguments, and a call-order protocol that unchanged H0 cannot reach or control. The before=false, after=true truth-table result is NEW, which requires harness maintenance.
